raw.details:
Welcome to Hypnexis 2026 – Manipal University Jaipur's Premier 36-Hour Hackathon!

An electrifying 36-hour AI hackathon where innovation meets execution, bringing together student innovators from across the country.

About the Opportunity

Hypnexis 2026 is a premier AI hackathon by Manipal University Jaipur, designed to foster innovation, collaboration, and technological excellence. Participants will transform bold ideas into impactful solutions, build working prototypes, receive mentorship from industry experts, and compete for exciting prizes and recognition.

Eligibility

  • Open to students across all disciplines.

  • Each team must have 1–4 members.

  • Team members can belong to the same or different institutions.

Registration Fee

  • MUJ Students: ₹699 per team (1–4 members)

  • Non-MUJ Students (Indian): ₹849 per team (1–4 members)

  • International Students: USD 50 per team (1–4 members)

Payment Guidelines

  • Ensure the registration fee matches your eligibility category.

  • Incorrect registration categories or fee payments may lead to rejection.

  • Teams must provide the Team Leader's Name, Contact Details, and Valid Transaction ID.

  • Invalid transaction IDs, missing payment proof, or unsuccessful payments will result in disqualification.

  • The registration fee is non-refundable.

Competition Structure

The hackathon consists of three phases:

Phase 1- Online PPT Submission Round

  • Registered teams will submit a PPT presenting their proposed solution/idea through Unstop.

  • Submissions will be evaluated on innovation, problem understanding, technical feasibility, impact, scalability, and presentation quality.

  • Shortlisted teams will qualify for the 36-hour Offline Hackathon at Manipal University Jaipur.

  • PPT Submission Begins: 1st October 2026.

  • Shortlisted teams will receive further communication via email.

Perks:

  • Blockchain-based participation certificates.

  • Detailed evaluation insights.

  • Partner perks such as discount vouchers, software credits, and learning resources.

Phase 2- Offline Overnight Hackathon

  • Shortlisted teams will compete in a 36-hour hackathon at Manipal University Jaipur.

  • The offline round commences on 24th October 2026.

  • Problem statements will be revealed at the commencement of the event.

  • Teams will build innovative solutions with guidance from industry mentors and present their projects before the Grand Jury.

Phase 3- Offline Grand Finale

  • Shortlisted teams will compete in the Grand Finale on 25th October 2026 at Manipal University Jaipur.

Rewards & Recognition

  • Cash prizes for winning teams.

  • Special category awards.

  • Internship and networking opportunities.

  • Placement opportunities/incentives.

  • Blockchain-based certificates for finalists and participants.

  • Exclusive merchandise and goodies.

  • Letters of Recommendation and incubation opportunities.

General Rules

  • Teams must follow all deadlines and event guidelines. Violations may result in disqualification.

  • Decisions of the judges and organizers will be final and binding.

  • Plagiarism or unethical practices will not be tolerated. All submissions must be original.

Note

Common restrooms will be provided for participants, separately for boys and girls, at no additional cost. Meals will also be provided to participants during the offline hackathon at a minimal rate.

For queries join: https://chat.whatsapp.com/EfNqWrhFccOIyVYwYThiuG
